bagPolicy.summary: Clear bags are not required for Scope Arena; staff may search all patrons and inspect or empty bags. The exception requiring clear bags at SevenVenues applies to Norfolk Tides games at Harbor Park.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: The Scope Garage and nearby facilities provide more than 3,500 spaces; the listed special-event rate for Scope Garage and Bank Street Garage is $10 but varies by event. The Scope Garage can fill during major shows.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The operator’s A–Z guide and Scope parking page do not designate an app-based rideshare pickup location.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Concession stands at most events sell snacks and alcoholic and nonalcoholic drinks; purchases are cashless. Outside food and beverages are prohibited.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Accessible spaces are near the Chrysler Hall elevator and Scope lower-concourse doors in the Scope Garage and require a valid disability placard or plate. Accessible seats are available via the box office or online.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: SevenVenues does not permit re-entry after a guest leaves.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: Collect Will Call tickets at the venue box office beginning one hour before showtime and show valid photo ID. The Scope Arena box office is outside the lower concourse.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: Venue box offices open one hour before showtime on event days. Admission can require metal-detector screening and mobile tickets must be presented from the Ticketmaster app or mobile wallet.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
